description: This file defines a set of validation rule functions for form inputs, including checks for required fields, character length constraints, numeric ranges, email and phone formats, and special character restrictions.

methods.name: required
methods.description: Checks if a value is present and valid, handling strings, numbers, arrays, and objects.

methods.name: shouldNotExceedCharLength
methods.description: Returns a validation function that checks if a string's length does not exceed a specified maximum.

methods.name: validRange
methods.description: Returns a validation function that validates whether a numeric string falls within a specified range.

methods.name: digitsOnly
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only digits.

methods.name: validEmailFormat
methods.description: Validates that a string matches a common email address pattern.

methods.name: validPhoneNumberFormat
methods.description: Validates that a string contains only allowed phone number characters.

methods.name: shouldNotLessThanCharLength
methods.description: Returns a validation function that checks if a string has at least a specified minimum length.

methods.name: shouldNotContainSpecialChars
methods.description: Returns a validation function that ensures a string contains only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

ctags.name: digitsOnly
ctags.pattern: /^export const digitsOnly = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: validEmailFormat
ctags.pattern: /^export const validEmailFormat = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/
